name: reference scientific-action dependency graph
ordering_policy: partial order; equivalent Actions and Backends are allowed when scientific invariants are preserved

modes.candidate_assisted: classify and validate the 66 supplied mixed candidates
modes.open_path_search: start from 27 reactant-side conformers and locate transition states and downstream intermediates

nodes.goal: audit structures, charges, multiplicities, hashes, duplicates and obvious geometry failures
propose pyridyl-pyridyl, phenyl-pyridyl, C-O and alternative concerted or stepwise hypotheses
screen and optimize candidate conformers at controlled cost
locate missing transition states in open_path_search mode or refine supplied TS candidates
nodes.mode_requirement: mandatory for open_path_search; conditional refinement for candidate_assisted

nodes.goal: classify minima and transition states by Hessian and target normal mode
prove chemical connectivity of every key transition state
compute consistent high-level electronic energies for all accepted competing pathways
nodes.paper_reference_backend: ORCA 4.0.1.2 SMD-DLPNO-CCSD(T)/cc-pV(DT)Z with Gaussian large-basis DFT check

nodes.goal: quantify protonation effects and BiPy/PhPy/C-O selectivity
classify the reaction coordinate as concerted or stepwise and synchronous or asynchronous
integrate calculations with relative rates, NMR, selectivity and EtONa observations
produce a reproducible report with failures, provenance, uncertainty and structured final claims

hard_invalidations: a claimed transition state lacks target-mode and IRC validation
competing barriers mix methods, temperatures or standard states
paper-published rounded values are silently substituted for recomputed results
rate-limiting and selectivity-determining steps are conflated
failed calculations are omitted from provenance
